hero.filename: 2014 MAY-14 Beginning of Cocos Fire with Washingtonia Fire.jpg
hero.title: File:2014 MAY-14 Beginning of Cocos Fire with Washingtonia Fire.jpg
hero.source: 2014 MAY-14 Beginning of Cocos Fire with Washingtonia Fire
hero.description: This photo shows the beginning time frame of the Cocos Fire. In the background, up on the hill, is the last remnant smoke from the Washingtonia Fire - whose embers started the Cocos Fire, according to testimony in court. This photo was used in the trial of the juvenile found guilty of setting the fire.  Google pin points to San Marcos, California as location.

gallery.description:
Since I was in the area at the time, this is a night shot I took of one of the w:May 2014 San Diego County wildfires.  In particular, this is the w:Cocos Fire burning above w:California State University San Marcos on the night of May 14, 2014.
